title: Insurance Contract Law, 5741-1981
source_id: Sefer HaChukim 5741 (ס״ח תשמ״א), p 94; Wikisource page: חוק חוזה הביטוח
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק חוזה הביטוח; the heading prints the title as חוק חוזה הביטוח, התשמ״א–1981. The header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשמ״א, 94|חוק חוזה הביטוח|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/9/law/9_lsr_208385.pdf}}, i.e. Sefer HaChukim 5741 p 94, enacted 28 Shevat 5741 (2 February 1981). Section 75(a) sets commencement at 6 Tevet 5742 (1 January 1982), with a three-month deferral for s 28(a) — so the whole Law has long been in force. Highest-year amendment box in the wikitext is ס״ח תשפ״ד, 160 (Amendment No 9 to the Adjudication of Interest and Linkage Law), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_3568695.pdf, published 13 November 2023. Consolidation last edited 8 September 2026.
notes: This is the general contract-law statute for insurance: formation, disclosure, the insurer's duties on notification of a loss, time limits and payment of indemnity. It is the right core instrument for an insurance-claims encoding. Two things a human should weigh before encoding: (1) insurer conduct on claims handling is also regulated administratively under the Supervision of Financial Services (Insurance) Law, 5741-1981 (חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (ביטוח)) and the Capital Market Authority Commissioner's circulars, which were NOT verified in this pass; (2) the Law is a Knesset Law, not a Mandate-era Ordinance, and is not part of any code, although it sits alongside the other contract statutes that the draft Civil Code project has long proposed to consolidate — no replacement Act is in force.
